"name": "Checkout delivery"
"on":
  "pull_request":
    "branches":
      - "main"
"permissions":
  "contents": "read"
"jobs":
  "validate":
    "runs-on": "ubuntu-latest"
    "steps":
      -
        "uses": "actions/checkout@v6"
        "with":
          "persist-credentials": false
      -
        "uses": "actions/setup-node@v7"
        "with":
          "node-version": 24
      -
        "run": "npm ci"
      -
        "run": "npm run lint"
      -
        "run": "npm test"
"concurrency":
  "group": "all-reviews"
  "cancel-in-progress": true
export const checkoutTotal = (prices) => prices.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0);

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
rm -rf -- dist node_modules reports
rm -f -- .env credentials.json
